question: According to the 2025 Global Report on Food Crises by the FAO, how many people suffered from acute food insecurity in 2024?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**295 million**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Global Hunger Crisis Worsens in 2024, 295 Million Face Acute Food Insecurity: FAO.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**FAO** published the **2025 Global Report on Food Crises**.

 
 
• 
 
In **2024**, **295 million people** faced **acute food insecurity** in **53 countries**.

 
 
• 
 
This is a rise of **13.7 million** from **2023**, and marks the **sixth consecutive annual increase**.

 
 
• 
 
**Conflicts** were the **main cause** in many areas.

 
 
• 
 
**Famine was confirmed** in:

 
 
• 
 
**Sudan**

 
 
• 
 
**Gaza**

 
 
• 
 
**South Sudan**

 
 
• 
 
**Haiti**

 
 
• 
 
**Mali**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Gaza** is at risk of **looming famine between May and September 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
Other factors worsening the crisis include:

 
 
• 
 
**Forced displacement**

 
 
• 
 
**Economic shocks**

 
 
• 
 
**Extreme weather events**
